sections.text: # Charlotte Catholic High School — Financial Aid & Tuition (Schedule and Aid Programs 2026-2027)
sections.t: # Charlotte Catholic High School — Èd Finansye ak Frè Eskolè (Bawèm ak Pwogram Èd 2026-2027)

sections.text:
- **School:** Charlotte Catholic High School, grades 9–12, part of **Mecklenburg Area
 Catholic Schools (MACS)**, Diocese of Charlotte.
sections.t:
- **Lekòl:** Charlotte Catholic High School, grad 9–12, ki fè pati **Mecklenburg Area
 Catholic Schools (MACS)**, Diocese of Charlotte.

sections.text: ### ⚠️ Tuition is set centrally by MACS, not by the school
sections.t: ### ⚠️ Se MACS ki fikse frè eskolè a santralman, se pa lekòl la

sections.text:
Unlike every independent school on this roster, CCHS does not set or publish its own
tuition. **MACS publishes one high-school schedule covering grades 9–12** at
discovermacs.org, and the school site links to it. That is why the source below is a
diocesan page rather than a school page.
sections.t:
Kontrèman ak chak lekòl endepandan sou lis sa a, CCHS pa fikse ni pibliye pwòp frè
eskolè li. **MACS pibliye yon sèl bawèm pou lekòl segondè ki kouvri grad 9–12** nan
discovermacs.org, epi sit lekòl la mete lyen an. Se poutèt sa sous ki anba a se yon paj
dyosèz olye ke yon paj lekòl.

sections.text: ### Tuition 2026-2027, grades 9–12
sections.t: ### Frè eskolè 2026-2027, grad 9–12

sections.text:
**The parishioner / non-parishioner split is a tuition structure no other school on this
roster shows.** A participating Catholic family pays **$6,521 less** than a community-rate
family for the same seat — a ~30% difference driven by parish participation rather than by
financial need. The app's `top-tuition` row uses the **$23,562** International rate as the
school's highest published tier, consistent with how that row is defined for other schools.
sections.t:
**Divizyon ant moun ki nan parwas la ak moun ki pa ladan l se yon estrikti frè eskolè
okenn lòt lekòl sou lis sa a pa montre.** Yon fanmi Katolik k ap patisipe peye **$6,521
mwens** pase yon fanmi nan to kominote a pou menm plas la — yon diferans ~30% ki soti nan
patisipasyon nan parwas la olye ke nan bezwen finansye. Liy `top-tuition` app la sèvi ak to
International **$23,562** la kòm nivo ki pi wo lekòl la pibliye, an kowerans ak fason yo
defini liy sa a pou lòt lekòl.

sections.text: ### Financial aid mechanisms
sections.t: ### Mekanis èd finansye

sections.text:
- **Family Individualized Tuition (FIT)** — the need-based program. Awards vary by family
 circumstance and fund availability.
- **Clarity** is the need-assessment application. ⚠️ **Not FACTS and not TADS** — FACTS
 appears in this system only as the **payment processor**, which is an easy
 mis-attribution. The Clarity application carries a **$65** fee.
- **Multi-child discounts** (participating Catholic families only): **2nd child 10%** ·
 **3rd child 25%** · **4th child 50%** · **5th and additional children 100%**.
- **NC Opportunity Scholarship Program (OSP)** — awards up to **$7,000+** annually, with
 **no income cap**.
- **Education Student Accounts (ESA+)** — **$9,000** or **$17,000** yearly for students with
 qualifying disabilities.
sections.t:
- **Family Individualized Tuition (FIT)** — pwogram ki baze sou bezwen an. Prim yo varye selon
 sitiyasyon fanmi an ak lajan ki disponib.
- **Clarity** se aplikasyon pou evalyasyon bezwen an. ⚠️ **Se pa FACTS epi se pa TADS** — FACTS
 parèt nan sistèm sa a sèlman kòm **moun k ap trete peman an**, sa ki se yon
 move atribisyon ki fasil. Aplikasyon Clarity la pote yon frè **$65**.
- **Rabè pou plizyè timoun** (sèlman pou fanmi Katolik k ap patisipe): **2yèm timoun 10%** ·
 **3yèm timoun 25%** · **4yèm timoun 50%** · **5yèm timoun ak lòt ki anplis 100%**.
- **NC Opportunity Scholarship Program (OSP)** — li bay jiska **$7,000+** pa ane, ak
 **okenn limit revni**.
- **Education Student Accounts (ESA+)** — **$9,000** oswa **$17,000** pa ane pou elèv ki gen
 andikap ki kalifye.

sections.text: ### Deadlines
sections.t: ### Dat limit

sections.text:
- **FIT applications: May 15** for returning students; new families are encouraged to apply
 alongside the admission application.
- **NCSEAA scholarship applications open in February** for the following school year.
- **2026-27 enrollment opens 3/23/26.**
sections.t:
- **Aplikasyon FIT: 15 me** pou elèv k ap retounen; yo ankouraje nouvo fanmi yo aplike
 ansanm ak aplikasyon admisyon an.
- **Aplikasyon bous NCSEAA yo louvri nan mwa fevriye** pou ane eskolè k ap vini an.
- **Enskripsyon 2026-27 louvri 3/23/26.**

sections.text: ### ⚠️ Two sources that are wrong, and are deliberately not ingested
sections.t: ### ⚠️ De sous ki mal, epi ke nou pa itilize espre

sections.text:
1. **PrivateSchoolReview lists CCHS tuition as $45,000.** That is **demonstrably wrong** —
 more than double the official community rate of $21,562 published by MACS itself. Not
 used.
2. **The CCHS page titled "Financial Aid and Scholarships" is about COLLEGE financial aid
 for seniors** (FAFSA, college scholarship search), **not** CCHS tuition assistance. It
 is an easy mis-ingest for a page with that exact title, and it is not the source of
 anything here.
sections.t:
1. **PrivateSchoolReview liste frè eskolè CCHS la kòm $45,000.** Sa **demontre klèman li mal** —
 plis pase de fwa to kominote ofisyèl $21,562 MACS li menm pibliye a. Nou pa
 itilize l.
2. **Paj CCHS ki gen tit “Financial Aid and Scholarships” la konsène èd finansye INIVÈSITÈ
 pou elèv dènye ane** (FAFSA, rechèch bous inivèsitè), **se pa** asistans frè eskolè CCHS. Li
 fasil pou fè yon move ingesyon ak yon paj ki gen egzakteman tit sa a, epi li pa sous
 anyen isit la.

sections.text: ### Confirmed structural nulls
sections.t: ### Nil estriktirèl ki konfime

sections.text:
- **`pct-aid`, `aid-awarded`, `avg-award` — permanently null.** MACS publishes aid figures
 **diocese-wide only**, never per school. There is no CCHS-specific percentage of students
 on aid, total aid awarded, or average award anywhere in the published record.
- **No Form 990 exists, structurally.** MACS operates under **EIN 56-1779865**, and
 ProPublica's Nonprofit Explorer states the organization "is not required to submit tax
 filings because the IRS designates it as a **religious organization**." **This is a
 permanent null, not a research gap** — no future pass will find a 990, and none should be
 spent looking. `hickory-grove-christian` already ships this same shape in the app.
- **`tuition-history` — not published.** MACS publishes only the **current** year's
 schedule. Secondary sources give conflicting older figures ($13,348 and $9,366) with no
 reliable year attribution; **those are not shipped**, because a tuition-history row built
 from unattributable figures is worse than no row. Archived MACS snapshots would be the
 path if this row is ever wanted.
sections.t:
- **`pct-aid`, `aid-awarded`, `avg-award` — nil pou tout tan.** MACS pibliye chif èd
 **pou tout dyosèz la sèlman**, pa janm pa lekòl. Pa gen okenn pousantaj elèv espesifik pou CCHS
 ki sou èd, okenn total èd yo bay, ni okenn prim mwayèn okenn kote nan dosye ki pibliye a.
- **Pa gen okenn Form 990 ki egziste, nan estrikti a.** MACS fonksyone anba **EIN 56-1779865**, epi
 Nonprofit Explorer ProPublica a di ke òganizasyon an “is not required to submit tax
 filings because the IRS designates it as a **religious organization**.” **Sa a se yon
 nil pèmanan, se pa yon mank nan rechèch** — okenn pas nan lavni p ap jwenn yon 990, epi nou pa dwe
 depanse tan chèche l. `hickory-grove-christian` deja gen menm fòm sa a nan app la.
- **`tuition-history` — pa pibliye.** MACS pibliye sèlman bawèm ane **aktyèl** la.
 Sous segondè bay ansyen chif ki kontredi youn lòt ($13,348 ak $9,366) san okenn
 atribisyon ane ki fyab; **nou pa pibliye sa yo**, paske yon liy istorik frè eskolè ki bati
 ak chif ou pa ka atribye pi mal pase pa gen liy ditou. Kaptè MACS achive yo ta chemen an
 si yo ta janm vle liy sa a.

sections.text: Fees
sections.t: Frè

sections.text:
Note the capital fee is charged **per family**, not per student — so it does not scale with
the number of children enrolled, unlike the application and enrollment fees.
sections.t:
Note yo chaje frè kapital la **pa fanmi**, se pa pa elèv — kidonk li pa monte ak
kantite timoun ki enskri, kontrèman ak frè aplikasyon ak enskripsyon yo.

sections.text: Note on the published 5.0% increase
sections.t: Nòt sou ogmantasyon 5.0% ki pibliye a

sections.text:
The school states that every band rose 5.0% from 2025–26 to 2026–27. The archived
2025–26 figures are close to, but **not identical to**, what a naive 2026–27 ÷ 1.05
calculation would produce — the school rounds each band to a clean figure. Examples:
sections.t:
Lekòl la deklare chak bann te monte 5.0% soti 2025–26 rive 2026–27. Chif 2025–26
ki achive yo pre, men yo **pa idantik**, ak sa yon kalkil naif 2026–27 ÷ 1.05
ta pwodui — lekòl la awondi chak bann nan yon chif pwòp. Egzanp:

sections.text:
This confirms the school's "5.0%" claim is accurate to rounding, and it validates using
the real published figures rather than the derived ones in any year-over-year chart.
sections.t:
Sa konfime reklamasyon "5.0%" lekòl la egzak jiska awondisman, epi li valide sèvi ak
vrè chif ki pibliye yo olye ke sa yo derive nan nenpòt tablo ane apre ane.

sections.text: ### The year-pinning decision
sections.t: ### Desizyon pou fikse ane a

sections.text:
**The app uses 2026-27 ($22,790, grades 9-12)** for `top-tuition` and every
tuition figure in prose, matching the 2026-27 basis used for the six existing
schools. The 2025-26 figures above exist so a reader reconciling against the
payment-terms PDF understands the two live years; no app figure mixes years.
sections.t:
**App la itilize 2026-27 ($22,790, grad 9-12)** pou `top-tuition` ak chak
chif frè eskolè nan pwoz, ki matche ak baz 2026-27 yo itilize pou sis lekòl
ki deja egziste yo. Chif 2025-26 ki anwo yo egziste pou yon lektè k ap rekonsilye
kont PDF kondisyon pèman an konprann de ane an dirèk yo; okenn chif app pa melanje ane.

sections.text:

sections.text: # Gaston Day School — Financial Aid & Tuition (Schedule and Aid Programs 2026)
sections.t: # Gaston Day School — Èd Finansye ak Frè Eskolè (Bawèm ak Pwogram Èd 2026)

sections.text:
- **School:** Gaston Day School, 2001 Gaston Day School Road, Gastonia, NC 28056.
- **Currency note:** every figure below is copied char-for-char from its source. Nothing is
 rounded, converted or re-typed.
sections.t:
- **Lekòl:** Gaston Day School, 2001 Gaston Day School Road, Gastonia, NC 28056.
- **Nòt sou lajan:** chak chif anba a kopye mo pou mo apati sous li. Nou pa
 awondi, konvèti ni retape anyen.

sections.text: ### Tuition and fees 2025-2026
sections.t: ### Frè eskolè ak frè 2025-2026

sections.text:
**Note on the published "total".** Gaston Day publishes tuition and fees as separate columns
plus an explicit combined total. The Upper School sticker figure is therefore **$22,390**
(tuition $20,215 + fees $2,175) — that combined figure is what third-party sites quote as
the school's tuition, and it is the like-for-like number against other schools' all-in
figures.
sections.t:
**Nòt sou "total" ki pibliye a.** Gaston Day pibliye frè eskolè ak frè yo kòm kolòn apa
plis yon total konbine eksplisit. Kidonk chif afiche Upper School la se **$22,390**
(frè eskolè $20,215 + frè $2,175) — se chif konbine sa a sit twazyèm pati yo site kòm
frè eskolè lekòl la, epi se li ki chif konparab pou pa parèy ak chif tou konpri lòt lekòl yo.

sections.text:
**2026-27 tuition (S2):** **$20,300 – $23,310** depending on grade. Published as a range on
the cost page; the per-grade 2026-27 schedule PDF was not posted at the time of this pass.
sections.t:
**Frè eskolè 2026-27 (S2):** **$20,300 – $23,310** selon grad la. Pibliye kòm yon ranje sou
paj kou a; PDF orè 2026-27 pa grad la pa t afiche nan moman pas sa a.

sections.text: ### After school & enrichment rates (duplicated in the After School area)
sections.t: ### To pwogram apre lekòl ak anrichisman (yo repete nan zòn After School la)

sections.text:
**Rate conflict with the after-school web page — recorded, not silently resolved.** The
`/afterschoolprogram/` page states hours of **3:15 PM – 5:30 PM** and prices of
**$100/month** (Lower School) and **$60/month** (Middle School), with drop-in at $30/day and
$15/day. The tuition schedule (S1) states **3:00–6:00** / **4:00–6:00** at **$95/week** and
**$55/week**, with the same $30/day and $15/day drop-in rates.
sections.t:
**Konfli to ak paj entènèt apre lekòl la — anrejistre, se pa rezoud an silans.** Paj
`/afterschoolprogram/` la deklare orè **3:15 PM – 5:30 PM** ak pri **$100/mwa** (Lower School)
ak **$60/mwa** (Middle School), ak vini yon jou konsa a $30/jou ak
$15/jou. Orè frè eskolè a (S1) deklare **3:00–6:00** / **4:00–6:00** a **$95/semèn** ak
**$55/semèn**, ak menm to $30/jou ak $15/jou pou vini yon jou konsa.

sections.text:
The drop-in rates agree exactly across both sources. The weekly-vs-monthly labels do not:
$100/**month** for daily aftercare would be far below $30/day drop-in economics and below the
schedule's own $95/week, so the page's "/month" reads as a label error for a weekly rate.
Both sources are retained above; the app uses the **official tuition schedule (S1)** as the
rate authority and the **web page (S2/after-school file)** for the current operating window,
which is the more likely thing to have been updated in-year. See the after-school file for
the full page transcription.
sections.t:
To pou vini yon jou konsa yo dakò egzakteman nan toude sous yo. Etikèt pa semèn kont pa mwa yo pa dakò:
$100/**mwa** pou gadri chak jou ta byen anba ekonomi $30/jou vini konsa a epi anba
$95/semèn orè a li menm, kidonk "/mwa" paj la li tankou yon erè etikèt pou yon to pa semèn.
Toude sous yo kenbe anwo a; app la sèvi ak **orè ofisyèl frè eskolè a (S1)** kòm
otorite to a epi ak **paj entènèt la (S2/dosye apre lekòl la)** pou fenèt operasyon aktyèl la,
ki se bagay ki pi posib pou yo te mete ajou nan mitan ane a. Gade dosye apre lekòl la pou
transkripsyon konplè paj la.

sections.text: ### Financial aid
sections.t: ### Èd finansye

sections.text:
- **Platform: Clarity** (not FACTS or SSS). Five steps: sign up at the Clarity app; add
 Gaston Day School to the applicant entry; complete the application and pay the **$65**
 fee; complete tax verification (IRS transfer or Clarity's option); submit and monitor the
 dashboard for document requests.
- **Deadline: rolling** — "The financial aid deadline is rolling, but funds may become
 limited or unavailable towards the beginning of the new school year (August)."
- **Three assistance channels:** need-based Financial Aid, Merit Scholarships, and the
 **North Carolina Opportunity Scholarship**.
- **Discount ceiling: up to 80%** of tuition (Kindergarten–Grade 12).
- **Contact:** Kevin Napp, Director of Admissions, 704.864.7744 ext. 414.
sections.t:
- **Platfòm: Clarity** (se pa FACTS ni SSS). Senk etap: enskri sou app Clarity a; ajoute
 Gaston Day School nan antre moun k ap aplike a; ranpli aplikasyon an epi peye frè **$65**
 la; ranpli verifikasyon taks (transfè IRS oswa opsyon Clarity a); soumèt epi siveye
 tablodbò a pou demann dokiman.
- **Dat limit: woulan** — "The financial aid deadline is rolling, but funds may become
 limited or unavailable towards the beginning of the new school year (August)."
- **Twa kanal asistans:** Financial Aid ki baze sou bezwen, Merit Scholarships, ak
 **North Carolina Opportunity Scholarship** lan.
- **Plafon rabè: jiska 80%** nan frè eskolè a (Kindergarten–Grade 12).
- **Kontak:** Kevin Napp, Director of Admissions, 704.864.7744 ext. 414.

sections.text:
**Not published** on any page found in this pass: the total aid budget in dollars, the
average award, the number of families receiving aid, sibling discounts, tuition-insurance
or refund-plan terms, and the payment-plan tiers (S1 states only that "Gaston Day offers a
variety of payment plans" and that all plans assume the tuition deposit and fees have been
paid). These are recorded as confirmed absences, not as unresearched gaps.
sections.t:
**Pa pibliye** sou okenn paj nou jwenn nan pas sa a: bidjè èd total la an dola,
bous mwayèn nan, kantite fanmi k ap resevwa èd, rabè pou frè ak sè, kondisyon asirans frè eskolè
oswa plan ranbousman, ak palye plan peman yo (S1 di sèlman ke "Gaston Day offers a
variety of payment plans" epi ke tout plan yo sipoze depo frè eskolè a ak frè yo peye deja).
Sa yo anrejistre kòm absans konfime, se pa kòm twou ki pa rechèche.

sections.text: ### Aid share
sections.t: ### Pòsyon èd la

sections.text: **26% of the student body receives tuition assistance** (2025-26 Academic Profile).
sections.t: **26% nan kò elèv la resevwa asistans pou frè eskolè** (Academic Profile 2025-26).

sections.text:
S5 (Private School Review) reports **45%**. The school's own profile is used. The two are
also not measuring the same quantity: the profile's "tuition assistance" is need-based aid,
while a third-party "percent on financial aid" figure commonly folds in merit awards and
state Opportunity Scholarship recipients — which at Gaston Day are three separate channels
(S2). The gap is therefore plausibly definitional rather than either figure being wrong.
sections.t:
S5 (Private School Review) rapòte **45%**. Se pwòp pwofil lekòl la nou sèvi. De yo pa
ap mezire menm kantite a non plis: "tuition assistance" pwofil la se èd ki baze sou bezwen,
tandiske yon chif twazyèm pati "pousantaj sou èd finansye" anjeneral mete ansanm bous merit ak
moun k ap resevwa Opportunity Scholarship eta a — ki nan Gaston Day se twa kanal apa
(S2). Kidonk diferans lan gen anpil chans se yon zafè definisyon olye ke youn nan chif yo pa kòrèk.
